purpose: Review guidance for complete raw validation before any lossy normalization; this is not an implementation patch or accepted new baseline.

domain_definitions.positive_oid: JSON integer with Python type int, excluding bool; 1 through 4294967295 inclusive. Zero is InvalidOid and cannot identify an actual row, relation or function.
domain_definitions.optional_oid: JSON integer with Python type int, excluding bool; 0 through 4294967295 inclusive. Zero denotes absent association or all databases/roles only in the corresponding documented field.
domain_definitions.boolean: Only JSON true/false. Integers 0/1 and null are not booleans.
domain_definitions.nonempty_text: JSON string with at least one character, including qualified/quoted SQL identities where emitted. Never null, array, object, bool or numeric.
domain_definitions.identifier: Nonempty JSON string emitted from PostgreSQL name field; installed PG17 name payload limit is 63 bytes. Portable internal names may differ but must retain their valid raw type.
domain_definitions.nullable_nonempty_text: null or nonempty_text; preserve null rather than replacing it with empty text.
domain_definitions.nonnegative_int16: JSON integer, excluding bool, in 0 through 32767. Trigger event bitmask is additionally limited by the PostgreSQL trigger macros and valid timing/event combinations; exact selected semantics remain required.
domain_definitions.relation_kind: Nonempty one-character PostgreSQL relation-kind string; selected required value is r.
domain_definitions.persistence: One of p, u, t; selected required value is p.
domain_definitions.replica_identity: One of d, n, f, i; selected required value is d.
domain_definitions.constraint_type: Nonempty one-character PostgreSQL constraint-type string; exact selected value remains required.
domain_definitions.trigger_enable_mode: One of O, D, R, A; selected required value is O.
domain_definitions.even_hex_text: JSON string with an even number of lowercase hex digits; empty string is valid for no arguments. Never null.
domain_definitions.int2vector_text: JSON string encoding attribute numbers; empty string is valid for all-column/non-column-specific trigger. Never null.
domain_definitions.nullable_trigger_parent: null or an object with exactly relation:nonempty_text and name:identifier.
domain_definitions.nullable_parameter_acl_entries: null or array of exact objects grantor:nonempty_text, grantee:nonempty_text, privilege:SET|ALTER SYSTEM, grantable:boolean. Preserve every entry and multiplicity.
domain_definitions.nullable_config_array: null or array of nonempty JSON strings representing PostgreSQL name=value settings. Preserve every entry and multiplicity.

legacy: Exact frozen legacy object and all retained values must remain equal after only documented membership-list ordering; no legacy SQL or value selection change is requested.
shape_rules: Every listed object has exactly the listed required keys; arrays contain objects of the corresponding exact shape. Unknown, missing and duplicate JSON keys reject.
All list entries and multiplicities remain present. A row OID is positive and unique within its collected group before OID removal.

Trigger relation_oid/function_oid are positive. constraint_oid, referenced_relation_oid, constraint_index_oid and parent_oid are zero exactly when corresponding identity is null; nonzero references require resolved identities.
Constraint parent_oid is zero exactly when parent_identity is null. Startup database_oid/role_oid zero means wildcard *; positive entries require a resolved database/role name.
Registered settings have actual text context. Unregistered parameter ACL names have context null and registered=false; selected_set must remain true.

All malformed type and range validation occurs before deleting internal name/definition or OID transport fields. Retained non-null strings cannot turn into null, objects or lists; booleans cannot become integers.
Valid OID changes, internal generated-name changes and harmless internal DDL formatting changes must remain portable after validated semantic normalization.
Raw nullable ACL/default fields reflect SQL output possibility; any unselected actual entry still fails exact comparison with the separate frozen manifest.
